hero.description: A quiet system monitoring and insights app designed to reveal what is happening beneath your workflow.

featureSections.statement: Understanding your Mac should not mean watching it all day.
featureSections.description: Monitor turns the activity beneath your workflow into useful context—not a stream of alerts. It stays clear, quiet, and ready when a closer look matters.

featureSections.title: See the state of your Mac as it changes.
featureSections.description: Monitor brings the signals worth noticing into one calm view, so CPU, memory, storage, and network activity can be understood without digging through utilities or interrupting the task at hand.

featureSections.title: Notice the shape of a day, not just a moment.
featureSections.description: A single reading rarely tells the whole story. Monitor makes room for patterns to emerge, helping you understand what is normal for your Mac and what has genuinely changed.

featureSections.title: Find the cause without the noise.
featureSections.description: When something feels off, Monitor is there to help make sense of it. The goal is not more data, but a clearer path from a question to an answer.

featureSections.title: A technical tool with a quieter presence.
featureSections.description: Monitor is designed to be useful at a glance and unobtrusive the rest of the time. Its information is precise, but its presence is deliberately restrained.

featureSections.statement: A clearer relationship with the machine you use every day.
featureSections.description: Monitor is being shaped as a companion for people who care about their tools: a more attentive way to understand a Mac without asking it to become the centre of attention.
